_note: EXAMPLE SHAPE ONLY — values are per-deployment. The live /terms.json generated from orchestrator config is canonical; the on-chain resourceURI points at it, never at this file.
name: Coalition Pool #1 — Shared VPS Window

funding.rule: Atomic settle to provider at threshold; full refund past deadline if unfilled; over-commit capped at target

allocation.remainder: 819x5=4095; 1 MB stays unallocated with the pool (integer shares)
allocation.metering: CU-seconds and MB-hours tracked per wallet; overruns throttled/killed

forfeiture.rule: Dropout stake stays locked, counts toward target, redistributed pro-rata (settle: remainder splits the resource; refund: remainder splits the tokens)
forfeiture.reputation: Dropout recorded as -1 feedback, completion as +1, tag2 pool

resale.pricing: cost basis only (~0.00244 USDC/MB, ~0.139 USDC/CU-hour); no auction pricing
resale.rails: x402 via Gateway batching preferred, direct USDC transfer as fallback
resale.effect: Quota shifts seller to buyer on confirmed payment; evolution toward 1:1 price-to-use

settlement.method: atomic transfer to provider; anyone may call once filled
